title: Linear-threshold conjecture for connected size Ramsey numbers of star matchings
source: Fanghua Guo, Yanbo Zhang and Yunqing Zhang, “Matching-star size Ramsey numbers under connectivity constraint”, arXiv:2404.03175 (2024); journal version 2025, Conjecture 1.3. (https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.03175)

lanes.final_paper_definition_and_prior_art_che: final-paper-check-362603-opus-20261119-r1/CHECK-362603.md (Claude Opus 5.5, PASS WITH EDITORIAL EDITS; revised paper used)

significance.root_decision: For all positive integers n, p, m with m >= 5(n+p), the connected size Ramsey number of n vertex-disjoint stars K_{1,p} (red) against a star K_{1,m} (blue) equals n(m+p)-1: the minimum number of edges of a finite connected simple graph every red/blue edge colouring of which contains a red nK_{1,p} or a blue K_{1,m}. This proves the linear-threshold conjecture of Guo, Zhang and Zhang with c = 5; the source had the formula only for m >= (n^2+2pn+n-3)/2. Lean proves both the upper bound by construction and the lower bound for every connected graph with fewer edges. The constant 5 is not optimised; no constant c <= 2/3 can work (referee's computation at (n,p,m) = (2,1,2)).
significance.caveat: The constant 5 is not optimised. Bounded literature search only; the 2025 journal version still lists the conjecture as open. Two references the referee could not verify (arXiv:2606.04439, arXiv:2604.17356) were removed from the revised paper.

root_basis: Root extracted the nine modules from the appendix into an empty directory, rebuilt and kernel-checked them (all exit 0, axioms exactly the allowed three, no forbidden tokens), and screened the Principia archive (300 ids), the omega registry and GitHub by id. An independent Opus referee compared the Lean definitions word by word with the source, computed the true value exhaustively for all 62 triples with n(m+p)-1 <= 11, tested the colouring on 3,300 random graphs, read the paper line by line and supplied the revised paper used here.
